actors.name: David Cameron
actors.private_context: Cameron is Prime Minister and has called the EU referendum for 23 June 2016. He is leading the Remain campaign. He has not yet decided whether to appear in any televised set-piece events, but is aware of the campaign schedule and media requests.

shared_context: The EU referendum is scheduled for 23 June 2016. Televised set-piece events (such as debates or major interviews) are being organized by broadcasters. The campaign period is ongoing, and the public expects to see leading figures from both sides in such events.

starting_events.description: The campaign for the EU referendum is underway. No televised set-piece event featuring David Cameron has yet occurred, and no specific event has been confirmed for him.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before 23 June 2016 (polling day), the persistent event history shows that David Cameron appeared in at least one televised set-piece event (e.g., a debate, a major interview, or a televised town hall) about the EU referendum. Otherwise resolve NO at the close of polling day.
